daily-reflect v1.0.0 — Initial release

- New daily journaling assistant that provides a deep journal prompt each day.
- Morning writing guidance and evening reflection prompts to help build a consistent journaling habit.
- Supports emotion tracking, self-reflection, gratitude, growth, and mindfulness journaling.
- Users can manage prompt delivery times and channels (Telegram, Feishu, Slack, Discord).
- Triggers on keywords related to journaling, reflection, and daily writing.
